title: Considerations for Singapore’s Agreement to Malaysia’s Request to Postpone High-Speed Rail Project
what_it_is: Considerations for Singapore’s Agreement to Malaysia’s Request to Postpone High-Speed Rail Project

sections.label: HSR suspension reimbursement and works
sections.summary: Question asks the basis for Malaysia's S$15 million reimbursement, major suspended works, and whether ancillary HSR works continue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) what was the basis for the agreed reimbursement of S$15 million by Malaysia to Singapore for abortive costs arising from the two-year suspension of works for the Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail (HSR); (b) what are the major works which will be suspended during the same period; and (c) whether there are any ancillary works or projects relating to or incidental to the HSR which will still continue in the next two years.

sections.label: Agreement to suspend HSR construction
sections.summary: Both sides agreed to suspend construction of the HSR Project up to 31 May 2020 after several rounds of discussions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: After several rounds of discussions, both sides reached agreement to suspend the construction of the HSR Project up to 31 May 2020.

sections.label: Malaysia reimburses Singapore abortive costs
sections.summary: Malaysia agreed to reimburse Singapore S$15 million for abortive costs, to be paid by end-January 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Malaysia has agreed to reimburse Singapore for the abortive costs of S$15 million, to be paid by end-January 2019.

sections.label: Mutual benefits of HSR Project
sections.summary: Both sides recognise the HSR Project's mutual benefits of improving connectivity, deepening people-to-people ties and catalysing economic cooperation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Both sides recognise the mutual benefits of the HSR Project, which will bring both countries closer together by improving connectivity, deepening people-to-people ties and catalysing further economic cooperation.

sections.label: AssetsCo tender aborted
sections.summary: The two HSR InfraCos jointly notified registered bidders that the AssetsCo tender was aborted as of 5 September 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The two HSR InfraCos, SG HSR Pte Ltd, and MyHSR Corporation, have jointly notified registered bidders for the AssetsCo tender that the AssetsCo tender has been aborted as of 5 September 2018.

sections.label: MRT skillsets for HSR suspension
sections.summary: LTA has enough MRT-related work to keep applicable skillsets usefully occupied during the two-year HSR suspension.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The reality is that within LTA, within Singapore, we have many Mass Rapid Transit (MRT)-related projects and the skillsets which are being exploited and applied for the MRT projects are totally applicable for HSR as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: So, within the suspension period of two years, we have enough work to keep them usefully occupied and we will do so.
